provenance.evidence: commit 9b9db79: 'The rewrite produced duplicate color=/opacity= kwargs -> SyntaxError: keyword argument repeated (#55), forcing scenes to fall back to plain text cards (sections 1/2/3 of every binary-search render).'

notes: Anti-regression (#55): valid VMobject fill_color/fill_opacity must SURVIVE untouched and stay parseable. Correct behavior is to change nothing, so the defect probe passes before and after by design — this case measures that Codeguard does NOT corrupt valid code.
